docs.text: Description ¶ A collection of DANS XML schemas. They mainly serve to support the DANS BagIt Profile v1 . To avoid dependencies on thirdparty sites hosting referenced schemas, copies of those schemas have been incorporated. Note, that this site may also include several legacy schemas carried over from the old EASY archival system.

docs.text: Development ¶ This page contains information for developers about how to contribute to this project. Submodules ¶ This project contains the following submodules: lib : Contains the XML schema definitions and Java classes for validating them. rpm : Contains the configuration for building the RPM package. Unit tests ¶ To run the unit tests, use the following command in the root of this project: mvn test If you haven't built the project before, you might need to install the submodules to the local repository first: mvn install -DskipTests mvn test The tests validate the XSD files and check them against example XML files.
